claim: The only networking in the repo is HagIPC, a dev-only loopback TCP (127.0.0.1, default port 19000) text server injected via CreateRemoteThread(LoadLibraryW) that offers memory read/write, arbitrary function call, code-blob exec, MinHook probe hooks, watch and value scan; there is no game-to-game networking or Steam networking use.
evidence: Server.cpp:152 inet_pton(AF_INET, "127.0.0.1", &addr.sin_addr); // loopback ONLY; inject.ps1:2 "Classic LoadLibrary injection"
game_build_compatibility: Build-independent tool (works on RVAs supplied at runtime).
verification_method: Static read of repo source and grep for WSAStartup/socket/SteamNetworking.
limitations: Designed as an attached-debugger-level dev tool; executing it would violate Phase 1 rules and is a security risk if exposed.
next_experiment: None for Phase 1; for later phases its call-on-game-thread limitation (README) is a reminder that co-op sync code must marshal onto the main thread.
